narrative: Added scripts/write-pre-push-dev-log.mjs and lib collectors (repo-tree, git-snapshot, run-tests)
Added work-log/dev-logs/human/ + agent/ + templates + JSON schema v1
Consolidated artifacts write to file-exchange/exports/ (primary) and models/ (API mirror)
formatExchangeTimestamp now human-readable; imports/exports folders renamed

decisions.decision: Two dev-log types: human MD + agent JSON per push
decisions.rationale: Humans need narrative; agents need structured audit without parsing prose
decisions.tradeoff: Two files per push; paired by timestamp prefix

decisions.decision: Agent log uses dev-log-agent.v1 JSON with embedded treeText
decisions.rationale: Machine-readable decisions, tests, and full tree at push time

iterations.outcome: User could not find them; moved to exports root

tradeoffs: Full npm test on each pre-push log is slow but accurate
improvements: Agents resume from agent/*.json; humans read human/*.md
Mandatory repo tree in every pre-push entry
risks: Skipped if push without running dev-log:pre-push
followUps: Install optional git pre-push hook with DEVLOG_STRICT=1
